final: SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_records, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p2 ON p2.ID = l.ID) AS share_of_total, COUNT(*) - (SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p2 ON p2.ID = l.ID) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p3.SEX) FROM Patient p3 JOIN Laboratory l3 ON l3.ID = p3.ID) AS above_average FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory l2 JOIN Patient p2 ON p2.ID = l2.ID) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p3.SEX) FROM Patient p3 JOIN Laboratory l3 ON l3.ID = p3.ID)
